svg.title: BC337 ratgdo breadboard
svg.text: Every column of 5 holes (a–e, f–j) is one node.
Dots = where a lead or wire goes into a hole.
Q1, Q2, Q3 are all BC337.
Wires and resistors cross over holes they don't touch.
Flat face toward row j (toward you), legs down:
C – B – E, left to right. Check your kit's sheet:
if yours differs, swap the columns to match.
Garbled bytes: lower the RX pull-up to 4.7k.
